# Alok Plastics

> Alok Plastics is a Chandigarh-based manufacturer, established in 1998, of moulded plastic and steel spare parts for water coolers, display counters and deep freezers.

## Facts
- Established: 1998
- Location: Chandigarh, India
- Owner: Gopal Kumar
- CEO: Aalok Kumar
- Tagline: Crafted in Bharat, made for the world.
- Delivery: Pan Bharat delivery network
- Company-reported: 20 Cr+ products successfully delivered
- Company-reported: 70%+ repeat customers

## Contact
- Address: Plot No-06, Industrial Area Phase II, Ram Darbar, Chandigarh - 160003, India
- Enquiries and quotes: https://alokplastics.com/enquiry/ (prices are shared on request, per part and quantity)

## Products

### Sliding & Door Systems
Bushes, locks, hinges and springs for the sliding and hinged doors of display counters, deep freezers and industrial enclosures.
- [F-Bush](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/f-bush/): Nylon
- [Connecting Bush](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/connecting-bush/): Brass
- [Door Lock](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/door-lock/)
- [Hinge](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/hinge/)
- [Handle Lock](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/handle-lock/)
- [Bracket Handle](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/bracket-handle/)
- [SS Kabja](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/ss-kabja/): SS
- [L-Type Hinge](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/l-type-hinge/)
- [U-Type Door Spring](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/u-type-door-spring/)
- [L-Hinge Door Spring](https://alokplastics.com/products/sliding-door-systems/l-hinge-door-spring/)

### Water Control
Float valves, push cocks and waste pipes for water coolers, dispensers and related equipment.
- [Float Valve](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-control/float-valve/): Nylon
- [Push Cock](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-control/push-cock/): Brass
- [Waste Pipe](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-control/waste-pipe/): PPCP
- [Waste Coupling](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-control/waste-coupling/)

### Ventilation & Levelling
Ventilation jalli for airflow and adjustable leg inserts for levelling coolers, counters and freezers on uneven surfaces.
- [Ventilation Jalli](https://alokplastics.com/products/ventilation-levelling/ventilation-jalli/): PPCP
- [Adjustable Leg Insert](https://alokplastics.com/products/ventilation-levelling/adjustable-leg-insert/): HDPE

### Sealing
Gaskets for sealing refrigeration compartments, door frames and water-tight joints.
- [Gasket](https://alokplastics.com/products/sealing/gasket/)
